QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] A Newly Written History
QuestInfo.0:
You forgot about what Karen said. History must not be changed, but was the death of Ephenia set in history?
Read the #b<Chronicles of Ellin Forest>#k.
QuestInfo.1:
A new sentence was written in the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest>. Maybe it was just an unfounded fear of Karen that the set history must not be changed.
You could stop the tragedy of the forest. Save the pioneer who meets a tragic death in the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest>.
But you need to know who the pioneer in the book is to do that. Ask #bAthena Pierce#k about it.
QuestInfo.2:
A new sentence was written in the <Chronicles of Ellin Forest>. Maybe it was just an unfounded fear of Karen that the set history must not be changed. You could save the #rpioneer#k who met a tragic death in this forest and stop the tragedy of the forest from ever happening.
You asked Athena Pierce who the pioneer is, and she replied the one who fits that name is #bDestonen#k, who opened the path of the Pirate.

default.0: Talk to #bAthena Pierce#k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k and ask about the pioneer.
